rules: Every Go package directory under the source roots must appear exactly once in this manifest.
Forbidden imports are checked from Go import declarations, not from test fixture strings.
Public behavior must remain black-box testable without AWS credentials.
Runtime artifact CD is owned by this repository, while topology and private operator evidence remain outside it.
Direct Go module dependencies remain governed by dependency_allowlist.riido.json.

loop.observation: The manual module decomposition listed only a subset of the actual Go package surface.
loop.hypothesis: Scanning package directories against a manifest can keep surface-area documentation aligned with the codebase.
loop.execute: Generate this reader from the package manifest and verify package/import boundaries in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier checks package parity, duplicate ownership entries, forbidden imports, generated doc freshness, and evidence output.
loop.retrospective: This preserves the surface-area philosophy: many packages are fine when their observable ownership is explicit and verifiable.
